tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i zhal thang bris tho bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sku brnyan thang sku gsum bzhengs pa'i dang po gtso thang la gcig dbus su phung po'i bdud ser/ nyon mongs bdud dmar/ 'chi bdag bdud nag lha'i bu'i bdud sngon/ de rnams dar sna tshogs kyis stod g.yogs sham thabs ral pa'i thor gtsug rin chen rgyan phran bcas mgo g.yas g.yon du bstan pa kha bub 'gyel steng seng khri sna tshogs pad steng rdo rje ser po 'phred nyal lte bar zla gdan la shākya thub pa dkyus bzhin la sa gnon mnyam bzhag rdor skyil/ de'i pad zla la byams ser g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i rnga yab/ g.yon klu shing gi yal ga la me tog rgya lcam 'dra bas mtshan pa/ g.yon du pad zla la spyan ras gzigs dkar po g.yas rin chen rnga yab/ g.yon pad dkar gnyis ka'ang zhabs mnyam bzhengs rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' phyag stabs ci mdzes/ de'i mtha' skor steng nas cha snyoms par bgos la/ ༈ yi ge drug pa dkar po phyag dang po gnyis thal sbyar g.yas 'og ma shel phreng / g.yon 'og ma pad dkar/ rdor skyil rgyan na bza' dkyus 'gre/ g.yas g.yon du nor 'dzin dang / 'gro drug ma gtso 'dra de gsum pad dkar zla gdan/ ༈ yang rdo rje ser po 'phred nyal gyi steng pad zla la za ma tog bkod pa dkar po gong 'dra las g.yon 'og ma pad steng nor bu 'dzin pa dar sham steng stag lpags rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad zla la padma kha 'byed dkar po phyag dang po gnyis khu tshur bcings pa la thugs kar kha sbyar ba'i gung mo kha phye ba/ g.yas 'og ma mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'og ma pad dkar/ rdor skyil rgyan na bza' sogs/ ༈ yang pad zla la yi ge drug pa spyan gzigs dkyus 'gre/ g.yas su nor 'dzin dkar po phyag dang po gnyis thal sbyar/ g.yas 'og ma nor bu/ g.yon 'og ma pad dkar/ g.yon du 'gro drug ma dkar po phyag dang po gnyis thal sbyar/

g.yas 'og ma pu ti/ g.yon 'og mas pad dkar rgyan na bza' sogs/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la kha sar pa ṇi dkar po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad dkar sdong po phyed skyil/ g.yas su sgrol ljang g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon utpal/ de'i rgyab nor bzang ser po thal sbyar bar na shog ga li 'dzin pa/ g.yon du khro gnyer can ser 'dzum khro g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon dbyug gu rtse gsum/ de'i rgyab rta mgrin dmar po g.yas thugs kar gyen langs/ g.yon dbyug pa oṃ tshur spyan gsum pa/ de thams cad rin po che'i rgyan sogs/ rta mgrin khro bo/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la mkha' spyod spyan gzigs gtso 'khor lnga gong bzhin las/ shar du rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ lhor rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag byang du don grub ljang gu skyabs sbyin mnyam bzhag shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo utpal dkar po/ lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo utpal sngon po/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar po utpal dmar po/ byang shar du dbyings phyug ma dkar mo utpal dkar po/ de bzhin g.yon mchog sbyin/ rin po che'i rgyan sogs/ ༈ yang pad dmar la seng ge dkar mo ral dmar nyal stabs gdong gyen bltas rin po ches brgyan pa'i steng zla gdan la seng ge sgra dkar po/ g.yas pus steng skyabs sbyin/ g.yon sku rgyab gdan brten spyan gsum/ kriṣṇa sa ri'i nu khebs g.yon dar dmar sham gos tshangs skud nag po ma gtogs rgyan med/ rgyal po rol pa/ g.yas su tri shū la ljang gu la sbrul bris thang la sbrul gcig lhag dkar 'khril ba/ g.yon du pad dkar sdog dgu'i steng thod pa me tog sna tshogs kyis bkang steng ral gri me 'bar/ ༈ yang pad dmar zla gdan la ha la ha la dkar po rtsa zhal dkar g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum/ g.yas dang po mchog sbyin/

gnyis pa phreng ba/ gsum pa mda'/ g.yon dang po pus steng yum sku la 'khril ba ma yin pa'i pus steng du bzhugs pa'i nu ma nas bzung ba/ yum gyi nu ma/ g.yon gnyis pa pad dkar sdong bu yal ga gsum pa/ gsum pa gzhu/ gong gi pus steng yum gyi phyag zhabs/ yum g.yon padma g.yas yab kyi ltag na 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang thod pa dang zla ba phyed pa'i dbu rgyan/ rin chen rgyan dang stag sham/ zhabs rol pa'i stabs/ g.yas su sbrul dkris pa'i rtse gsum/ g.yon du pad steng thod pa/ ༈ yang pad dmar zla gdan gong yum gyi bzhugs tshul sogs 'dra gcig ༈ yang pad dmar zla gdan la rdo rje chos dkar po gong 'dra las g.yon dang po pad dkar/ gnyis pa yum bzhugs tshul gong dang 'dra gyi nu ma/ gsum pa gzhu/ gzhan 'dra/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la padma gar dbang dmar g.yon padma 'dzin pas mo rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing g.yas de'i kha 'byed tshul/ yum dmar mo yab la 'khyud pa/ shar du rnam gzigs ma dkar mo g.yon pad dmar/ lhor sgrol ljang g.yon pad ljang / nub tu pad dkar ser mo g.yon dbyug sngon/ byang du khro gnyer can dkar mo g.yon pad ser/ byang shar pad gnas ma ser mo/ g.yon pad dmar/ shar lhor pad dbang sngon mo g.yon pad dkar/ lho nub sna tshogs pad dkar g.yon pad sngon/ nub byang sna tshogs rdo rje ma ljang gu g.yon sna tshogs padma/ de thams cad g.yas pas g.yon padma kha 'byed tshul/ rgyan na bza' sems skyil/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la padma gar dbang dmar po phyag bco brgyad kyis sna tshogs padma re re 'dzin pa g.yas su sgrol ma dang nor bzang g.yon du khro gnyer can dang rta mgrin kha sar pa ṇi'i skabs ltar rgyan na bza' phyed skyil/ ༈ yang rlung dkyil sngon po gzhu lta bu 'chang bzung thur bstan chog ma gyen bstan ba dan dar dpyangs gzhu sne g.yas g.yon la brtags pa lta bu gyis mtshan steng du me dkyil gru gsum dmar po de steng chu dkyil zla ba lta bu bum pas mtshan pa/

de steng sa dkyil ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i steng ri rab phyogs mdog dkyus 'dra ba'i steng du pad zla la ha ri ha ri dkar po g.yas dang pos thugs kar thal mo gyen langs/ gnyis pa phreng ba/ gsum pa mchog sbyin/ g.yon gyi dang po na dbyug pa/ gnyis pa na kriṣṇa sā ri'i pags pa/ gsum pa na spyi blugs/ rgyan na bza' rol mo'i bzhugs stabs/ ༈ yang lug gnyis zhags pas sbrel ba'i steng pad dmar nyi gdan la spyan gzigs dmar po/ spyan gsum pa/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i zhags pa/ g.yon lcags kyu/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ sprin gseb mkha' 'gro ma bum thogs/ lha bu mchod 'dzin/ yang lha bu 'ga' zhig rol gsil/ rdung ba/ mi ma yin mgo dang keng rus kyis brgyan pa/ gdugs rnga yab thogs pa phran bu can/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la spyan gzigs dmar po g.yas gnyis na zhags pa dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na mda' dang gzhu/ dar dmar stod g.yog sham thabs/ rdor skyil/ g.yas su sgrol ljang / g.yon du khro gnyer can ser/ gnyis ka mnyam bzhengs/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon skyabs sbyin/ rgyan na bza'/ ༈ yang pad nyi la spyan gzigs dmar mo g.yon padma/ g.yas de'i kha 'byed/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad dmar steng kriṣṇa sā ri'i pags pa'i dbus su zla gdan la spyan gzigs ser po mgrin pa sngon po phyag mnyam bzhag steng thod pa rin po ches gang ba bsnams pa/ dgu ma zla phyed kyis brgyan pa/ sku la me tog sngon po kriṣṇa sā ri'i pags pa phrag pa la bkal ba stag sham nor bu dang bcas pa'i sbrul gnyis mgul la bcings nas gdengs ka dbu steng thon pa/ ༈ yang pad dmar nyi gdan la spyan gzigs nag po rtsa zhal mthing nag g.yas su dkar ba dang dmar ba'i zhal gnyis/ g.yon du ser ba dang ljang ba'i zhal gnyis thams cad kyang mche spyan gsum gsum/ ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas dang po na ḍā ma ru/

gnyis pa kha ṭwāṃ ga gsum pa lcags kyu/ bzhi pa zhags pa/ lnga pa rdo rje/ drug pa mda' rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa thod pa/ gsum pa padma/ bzhi pa nor bu/ lnga pa 'khor lo/ drug pa gzhu/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang thod skam dbu rgyan/ stag sham zhabs g.yas bskums/ g.yon brkyang / ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la spyan gzigs dkar po/ g.yas dang po mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa thal mo gyen bslang / gsum pa nor bu dkar po'i phreng ba/ bzhi pa mda'/ lnga pa nyi dkyil/ lag mthil du 'dzin/ drug pa rin po che khri/ g.yon gyi dang po padma/ gnyis pa ri rab/ gsum pa rtse gsum/ bzhi pa gzhu/ lnga pa spyi blugs/ drug pa me tog gi zhags pa/ rgyan na bza' dar dkar po'i ga shal/ zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhengs/ mdun du don yod lcags kyu dmar po/ g.yas gnyis na lcags kyu dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa dang padma/ rgyan na bza' dmar po/ g.yas su rta mgrin dmar po khro tshul dbu steng rta mgo ljang gu/ g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa sbrul rgyan stag sham g.yas brkyangs/ spyan gsum la/ rgyab tu ral gcig ma sngon mo/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang gri gug g.yon gnyis na uta sngon dang thod pa/ ral pa dmar ser lan bu gcig pa khro mo'i nyams can/ spyan gsum pa/ sbrul dang me tog ser po'i do shal/ glang pags stod g.yog stag sham g.yas brkyangs/ g.yon du khro gnyer can ser g.yas gnyis na padma dang phreng ba/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pas spyi blugs/ zhi nyams ral pa'i thor tshugs/ dar dkar stod g.yog rgyan na bza'/ g.yon brkyang bol la g.yas pa'i sor mo brten nas bzhengs pa/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la spyan gzigs dmar po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon dmar rgyan na bza'/ zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhengs/ g.yas zur mdun du spyan ma dkar mo/ de rgyab mā ma kī sngon mo/ g.yon zur mdun du gos dkar mo dmar mo/

de rgyab sgrol ljang / de thams cad pus btsugs thal sbyar rgyan na bza' sogs/ ༈ yang pad zla la 'jam dbyangs dmar ser g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon pu ti thugs ka rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang seng sngon nyal stabs mgo gyen bstan steng pad zla la 'jam dbyangs dmar ser g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon uta sngon/ rgyan na bza' rol stabs/ g.yas nor bzang ser po pu ti mchan khung bzung zhing thal sbyar/ rgyan na bza' g.yon du gshin rje nag po khro nyams g.yas tho ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub bzhugs stabs gang 'os/ g.yas su lha bu nyi ma dmar po pad steng gnyis skyil/ g.yon du zla ba dkar po pad steng zla phyed zhabs mnyam bzhengs rgyan na bza'/ phyogs bzhir gong du bstan pa ltar rigs lnga dkyus 'gre/ mtshams bzhir yum bzhi dkyus 'gre/ ༈ yang seng sngon nyal stabs mgo gyen bstan steng sna tshogs pad zla la 'jam dbyangs dmar ser chos 'chad phyag rgya'i uta sngon re re 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyangs g.yon phyed skyil/ rgyan na bza'/ ༈ yang seng sngon nyal stabs mgo gyen bstan steng sna tshogs pad zla la 'jam dbyangs dmar ser g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon utpal rgyan na bza' rol stabs/ ༈ yang seng sngon pad zla la 'jam dbyangs ser po chos 'chad phyag rgya/ uta steng pu ti re re 'dzin pa/ rgyan na bza' rol stabs/ g.yon du gshin rje sngon po khro tshul/ g.yas gtso bo'i ngar gdang g.yon dbyug pa thod pa skam rlon stag sham/ ༈ yang seng sngon pad zla la 'jam dbyangs bshad ma thag pa'i g.yas su nor bu bzang ser po pu ti mchan bcug thal sbyar/ rgyan na bza' mnyam bzhengs/ g.yon du gshin rje nag po khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs/ g.yas tho ba g.yon sdigs mdzub bzhugs stabs gang bde/ ༈ yang seng sngon pad zla la 'jam dbyangs de 'dra ba gtso rkyang / ༈ yang seng sngon pad zla la 'jam dbyangs de 'dra ba gtso rkyang / ༈ yang pad dmar zla gdan la 'jam dkar g.yas ral gri 'phyar stabs/

g.yon pu ti thugs ka dar dmar sham thabs/ rdor skyil/ na bza' rgyan/ phyogs bzhir gtso bo 'dra ba'i 'khor bcas/ ༈ ras gzhi gcig la yang pad dmar zla gdan la sku mdog dmar ser gyi khyad ma gtogs bshad ma thag pa'i gtso 'khor lnga/ ༈ yang pad zla la 'jam dbyangs ser po g.yas kyi dang pos utpal dmar pos mde'u byas pa'i mda' dang g.yon pas me tog gi gzhu sbyar nas rna ba'i drung du 'gengs pa g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang me tog g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis uta sngon dang shing gis yal ga dmar po rgyan na bza'/ g.yon brkyangs g.yas phyed skyil/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la chos dbyings gsung dbang zhal bzhi thams cad spyan gnyis dkar ba dang po gnyis chos 'chad g.yas gnyis pa na ral gri gsum pa mda'/ bzhi pa na rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis pa pu ti/ gsum pa gzhu/ bzhi pa dril bu/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈5 yang sna tshogs pad zla la chos dbyings dbang dmar po/ rtsa zhal dang g.yas zhal dmar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ser/ dang po gnyis na mda' gzhu/ g.yas gnyis pa zhags pa/ gsum pa pu ti/ bzhi pa rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis pa lcags kyu/ gsum pa ral gri/ bzhi pa dril bu/ rgyan na bza' rol stabs/ ༈ yang chu dkyil zlum steng pad dkar zla gdan la chos dbyings gsum dbang dkar po mnyam bzhag rdor skyil rgyan na bza'/ ༈ sna tshogs pad zla la ngag gi dbang phyug dkar po g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pu ti thugs ka dar dmar stod g.yog sham thabs/ rgyan rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad zla la dpa' bo grub pa dkar po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon utpal/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la ngag gi dbang phyug dmar po mnyam bzhag rdor skyil rgyan na bza'/ ༈ yang seng khri pad zla la rgyal po rol pa ser po g.yas pus steng kha phub/ g.yon uta yu thugs kar 'dzin pa'i me tog snyan thad khar phye ba/ rgyan na bza' dor stabs/ ༈ yang de 'dra ba gcig ༈ yang pad zla la bung ba myos pa dmar ser rtsa zhal dmar ser g.yas sngo/

g.yon dkar/ g.yas gsum na dang po ral gri/ gnyis pa mda'/ gsum pa mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum na dang po pu ti/ gnyis pa utpal/ gsum pa gzhu/ me tog sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang rin po che'i na bza'/ gong 'og zhabs sems skyil/ ༈ yang pad zla la shes rab 'phel ba dkar po g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pu ti/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad zla la shes rab 'khor lo dkar po/ g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pu ti rgyan na bza' sems skyil/ ༈ yang chu skyil zlum steng pad dkar zla gdan la chos dung ting 'dzin dkar po mnyam bzhag rdor skyil/ rgyan na bza'/ ༈ yang pad zla la 'jam dbyangs sku dang bcas rtsa zhal dmar skya/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar/ zhal rnams spyan gnyis/ g.yas dang po ral gri/ g.yon dang po pu ti/ g.yas gnyis pa mda'/ g.yon gnyis pa gzhu/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la 'jam rdor sku dang rtsa zhal li khri/ g.yas sngon g.yon dmar spyan gnyis gnyis dang po gnyis thugs kar 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis ral gri ljang mda'/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis gzhu uta sngon/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad nyi la mi g.yo sngon po ral gri zhags pa khro bo'i spyan gnyis aṃ gtsigs/ ral nag thor tshugs sbrul dkar do shal rin chen rgyan/ dar gyi lhab lhub/ stag sham/ g.yon pa'i pus mo dang / g.yas rting nyi gdan la btsugs pa'i bzhugs stabs/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la sgrol ljang g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon utpal/ rgyan na bza'/ g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum phyed skyil/ g.yas su pad zla la 'od zer can dmar ser g.yon shing gi yal ga g.yon du ral gcig ma nag mo g.yon thod pa/ gnyis ka g.yas rnga yab/ rgyan na bza'/ mnyam bzhengs/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la sgrol ma sngon mo g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon utpal/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla la sgrol ljang dkyus 'gre'i g.yas su 'od zer can ser mo g.yas shing thog

g.yon yal ga g.yon du rma bya chen mo ljang ser g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon rma bya'i mjug sgro/ de g.yon ral gcig ma nag mo/ skra brdzes spyan gsum mche gtsigs stag sham/ gri gug thod pa/ de g.yon dug sel ma ljang gu g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon sbrul nag zhags pa/ 'khor 'di rnams bzhengs stabs rgyan na bza'/ ༈ yang pad zla la sgrol ma sku dang rtsa zhal ser po/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ rgyab dkar spyan gsum gsum zhi nyams/ g.yas dang po rdo rje/ gnyis pa mda'/ gsum pa dung / bzhi pa mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang po utpal/ gnyis pa gzhu/ gsum pa lcags kyu/ bzhi pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ phyogs bzhir zla gdan la mdun du me tog sgrol ma dkar mo me tog g.yas su bdug spos sgrol nag spos phor/ rgyab tu mar me sgrol ser mar me/ g.yon du dri sgrol dmar mo dung chos/ shar lhor 'khor lo/ lho nub tu rin chen/ nub byang du padma/ byang shar du dri/ de'i phyir phyogs bzhir nyi gdan la shar du lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu/ de'i steng gtsug tor rnam rgyal ser mo 'khor lo/ lhor zhags pa ma nag mo zhags pa/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma ser mo lcags sgrog de steng gnod mdzes ma nag mo sbrul zhags/ byang du dril bu ma dmar mo dril bu/ thams cad kyang g.yon sdigs mdzub/ spyan gsum 'dzum khro/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad dkar zla gdan la/ sgrol dkar mchog sbyin utpal/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad zla la sgrol ljang gtso dgu dkyus 'gre/ ༈ yang pad dkar nyi ma ro gdan la sgrol nag spyan gsum mche gtsigs skra kham thor tshugs/ thod skam dbu rgyan do shal/ sbrul rus/ stag sham/ dang po gnyis gri gug thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og g.yas 'og ma ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma uta sngon/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhengs pa/ ༈ yang pad dkar zla gdan sgrol dkar mchog sbyin uta dkar/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/

༈ yang ri rab dkyus 'gre'i steng pad dkar zla gdan la/ sgrol dkar spyan gsum ma/ dang po gnyis thugs kar sbyar te gung mo gnyis brkyang ba'i rgyab nas mdzub mo gnyis reg pa/ mthe bong gnyis gung mo la sbyar zhing mthe chung gnyis gshib te brkyang / srin lag gnyis bsnol ba/ g.yas 'og ma nor bu dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'og ma utpal/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ g.yas su pad zla la 'od zer can ser mo g.yas rnga yab g.yon yal ga stod g.yog dmar po/ sham thabs sngon po/ g.yon du pad zla la rma bya chen mo ljang ser g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon rma bya'i mjug sgro/ gnyis ka rgyan na bza' mnyam bzhengs/ ༈ yang pad zla la sgrol ma sku dang rtsa zhal dkar po g.yas ser/ g.yon sngo spyan gsum gsum/ g.yas dang po mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa phreng ba/ gsum pa mda'/ g.yon dang po utpal/ gnyis pa padma/ gsum pa gzhu/ dbu skra thor tshugs/ thod skam dang zla phyed dbu rgyan/ rgyan na bza'/ dur khrod du bzhugs pa/ zhi nyams phyed skyil te khyon nyer brgyad/ rten gtso gsum par spyan gzigs phyag bzhi pa dkyus 'gre/ sna tshogs pad zla la gnod sbyin sgrol ma ljang sngon zhal gcig spyan gnyis ral pa'i thor tshugs/ rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' 'od kyis rgyab yol/ g.yas gnyis na bgrang phreng mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis na utpal pu ti/ sems skyil/ de mdun rdo rje sgrol nag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yas su rin chen sgrol ser g.yas rin chen/ rgyab tu pad sgrol dmar mo g.yas padma/ g.yon du las sgrol ljang gu g.yas ral gri/ shar lhor me tog ma phreng ba/ lho nub tu spos ma nag mo spos phor/ nub byang du mar me ma ser mo g.yas mar me/ byang shar du dri sgrol dmar mo g.yas su dung chos/ thams cad g.yon utpal/ rgyan na bza' dkar mo g.yas me tog 'od bzhugs tshul gdan rnams gtso 'dra/ rdor sgrol ma'i mdun du lcags kyu ma nag mo g.yas lcags kyu/

rin sgrol ma'i g.yas su zhags ser g.yas zhags pa/ pad sgrol ma'i steng du lcags sgrog dmar g.yas lcags sgrog las sgrol ma'i g.yon du dril dkar/ g.yas dril bu/ bzhi ka g.yon utpal/ ral pa gyen du brdzes sbrul rgyan/ stag sham/ mche gtsigs spyan gnyis/ pad nyir g.yas brkyangs/ ༈ yang pad zla'i steng du ngan song las sgrol ma ljang gu zhal gcig spyan gnyis/ g.yas skyabs sbyin lcags kyu/ 'og ma mchog sbyin/ g.yon zhags pa 'og ma utpal/ rgyan na bza' dmar po sems skyil/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad nyi zla gdan la/ sna tshogs yum dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gnyis g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon pad dkar rgyan na bza' dkar po/ zhabs g.yas g.yon brang sbyar te bzhugs pa/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad zla'i steng dbang sngon drag nag tshangs ser khyab mjug sngon po rnams lha lus rgyan gos bcas 'gyel ba'i steng / don grub sgrol ma ser mo rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas dang po nag gnyis pa ljang / gsum pa sngo/ g.yon dang po dkar/ gnyis pa dmar/ gsum pa sngo/ steng zhal dud kha thams cad mche gtsigs spyan gsum/ g.yas brgyad na ral gri/ utpal/ mda'/ rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ gri gug skyabs sbyin/ g.yon brgyad na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ thod pa/ gzhu/ kha ṭwāṃ/ zhags pa/ tshangs mgo nor bu/ bum pa rnams 'dzin pa/ skra khams gyen brdzes/ thod skam dbu rgyan mgo rlon do shal/ dar gyis stod g.yogs sham thabs/ 'od dmar g.yon bskums dbang po/ g.yas brkyangs tshangs pa/ bar du drag po khyab mjug mnan pa/ pad nyi la dug sel ma sku dang zhal gsum ser/ spyan gsum/ mche gtsigs sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun skra thor tshugs me tog sngon po dang / rin po che sbrul rgyan dar sna tshogs kyis stod g.yogs sham thabs/ g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ me tog sngon po gzhu/ rol pa'i bzhugs stabs/ ༈ yang de 'dra ba gcig

༈ yang pad zla la dug sel ma ljang gu zhal gcig spyan gnyis ma g.yas gnyis na rtse gsum/ rma bya'i mjug sgro/ g.yon gnyis na sbrul zhags/ skyabs sbyin/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun/ gdu bu ske rags/ do shal rna rgyan rnams kyang sbrul sems skyil/ ༈ yang pad dkar zla gdan la dug sel ma dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gnyis ma/ rtsa phyag pi wang / g.yas 'og ma skyabs sbyin/ g.yon 'og ma sbrul dkar ral pa'i zur phud/ dar dkar stod g.yog g.yas rin po che dang sbrul dkar gyis brgyan 'od dkar gyis brgyan 'od dkar sems skyil/ ༈ yang nyi zla chos 'byung bdud bzhi thod pa dkar po'i steng du/ ral gcig ma sku dang rtsa zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal lnga'i dang po dkar/ gnyis ser/ gsum ljang / bzhi dmar/ lnga dud/ g.yon zhal lnga'i dang po dmar/ gnyis dkar/ gsum ser/ bzhi ljang / lnga dkar dmar/ steng dud kha mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum gsum/ phyag g.yas rnams na/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin po che'i khri/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ mdung / tho ba/ gtun shing / gri gug ḍā ma ru/ phreng ba rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams na gzhu/ zhags pa/ sdigs mdzub/ ba dan/ dbyug pa/ rtse gsum thod pa/ utpal/ dril bu/ satwa gri/ tshangs pa'i mgo thod pa rnams 'dzin pa/ skra kham gyen brdzes thod pa rnams gyon/ rus sbrul stag sham rnams kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums ro gdan/ ༈ yang pad ljang nyi gdan la/ ral gcig nag mo/ zhal gcig spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs skra kham gyen brdzes/ g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis kyi gri thod/ 'og gnyis ral gri utpal/ rin chen me tog sbrul rgyan stag sham/ thod rnams dbu rgyan g.yon brkyang / ༈ yang pad ljang nyi gdan la/ ral gcig ma nag mo zhal gcig spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ skra brdzes/ gri thod/ gzhan 'dra/ ༈ yang pad zla la tsandan dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi rnams g.yas dang po mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang po pad steng pu ti/ 'og gnyis mnyam bzhag steng lhung bzed/

rdor skyil rgyan na bza'/ ༈ yang rnam rgyal mchod rten nang / phag bdun gyi drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng bdud bzhi dang 'og tu gza' brgyad nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhis mtshon pa'i mi gzugs phran bu mnan pa'i steng 'od zer can sku dang rtsa zhal dkar po g.yas nag g.yon phag gdong dmar mo rgyab ljang / steng ser/ g.yas lnga na nyi dkyil/ rdo rje sngon po/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ khab/ g.yon lnga na zla dkyil/ gzhu shing gi yal ga sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ skud pa rnams/ ral pa'i thor tshugs/ rin po che'i rgyan/ stod g.yog dkar po/ zhabs bzhi brkyangs bskums/ gang bdes bdud bzhi mnan pa/ cung zad khro tshul spyan gnyis/ mdun du chu srin la/ phag gdong ma nag mo/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ g.yas su phag gdong ma dmar mo/ g.yas gnyis na lcags kyu/ khab/ g.yon gnyis na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ skud pa/ g.yon du phag gdong ma dmar mo/ dang po gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ g.yas mda'/ rdo rje/ g.yon gzhu yal ga rgyan na bza' gtso 'dra bzhengs stabs/ ༈ yang phag steng pad zla la 'od zer can ser mo/ zhal gcig spyan gsum/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon yal ga rgyan na bza' dkar po rol stabs/ ༈ yang rlung dkyil gzhu lta bu'i steng / 'dir phag mjug phyogs su 'jigs pa bur tshur gyis mnan pa/ gza' mgo dgu bya rog mgo bcas pa'i stod khog las med pa/ lag gnyis nyi zla 'dzin pa'i steng phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la rnam rgyal mchod rten nang pad ljang / nyi gdan la 'od zer can sku dang rtsa zhal ser po/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon phag gdong nag spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ g.yas dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa lcags kyu/ gsum mda'/ bzhi phag g.yon dang po na yal ga gnyis gzhu gsum skud pa/ bzhi sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ rin chen rgyan dang g.yer kha'i phreng ba/ dar dmar stod g.yog sham thabs/ g.yon brkyang / de mdun phag gdong ma dmar mo/

g.yas gnyis na khab lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa/ yal ga g.yas su bai ta li ser mo/ g.yas gnyis na yal ga khab/ g.yon gnyis na rdo rje/ zhags pa/ rgyab tu wa ra li dkar mo/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje/ khab/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa/ yal ga g.yon du wa ra ha mu khi'i dmar mo spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gnyis na rdo rje mda'/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa/ yal ga mdun g.yas rgyab kyi lha mo rnams spyan gnyis ma thams cad kyang khro mo/ rgyan na bza' gtso 'dra/ g.yon brkyang / yang dur khrod kyi dbus su/ chos 'byung dkar po la gnas pa'i nyi gdan la 'od zer can sku dang rtsa zhal dmar mo/ g.yas su ser po dang nag po'i zhal gnyis g.yon du dkar po dang nag po'i zhal gnyis/ steng du phag zhal nag po spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ g.yas drug na ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ rdo rje rtse gcig dgra satwa/ mda'/ gtun shing / g.yon drug na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i khab/ rtse gsum/ yal ga gzhu/ zhags pa/ tshangs mgo skra kham gyen brdzes/ thod skam dbu brgyan do shal/ rus rgyan/ stag pags kyis stod smad g.yog pa/ bdud bzhi'i steng na/ g.yon brkyang / de'i mdun na shing rta la gnas pa'i lha mo dmar mo/ g.yas sdigs mdzub/ g.yon yal ga ro gdan la bzhugs pa/ sbrul rgyan ma gtogs gzhan gtso 'dra/ yang byang chub mchod rten gyi nang brag steng zla gdan 'od zer can sku dang rtsa zhal ser po/ g.yas sngo g.yon dkar/ g.yas bzhi na rdo rje/ khab/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na zhags pa/ skud pa/ yal ga gzhu/ rgyan na bza'/ zhabs skyil krung gis dbang phyug u ma mnan pa/ ༈ yang rnam rgyal mchod rten gyi nang 'khor lo dkar po 'khor lo 'di'i gdan thabs kyi lte bar rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi gdan la 'od zer can sku dang rtsa zhal dmar po 'dzum mdangs/ g.yas g.yon gnyis su phag zhal dmar po dang dmar skya/ spyan gsum/ g.yas drug na khab/ lcags kyu/ gtun shing / ral gri/ rdo rje dbyug pa/

rdo rje/ g.yon drug na/ me tog dmar po/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ thod pa/ skud pa/ tshangs mgo bum pa/ skra ser/ gyen brdzes/ stod g.yog dar dmar/ stag sham/ rin rgyan/ g.yas brkyangs/ ༈ yang pad dkar zla gdan la ri khrod ma sku dang rtsa zhal ser po khro 'dzum/ g.yas zhi zhing dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing 'dzum khro/ spyan gsum/ g.yas dang po rdo rje thugs ka gnyis pa dgra satwa/ gsum pa mda'/ g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gnyis pa me tog dang 'bras bus sbrang yab/ gsum pa gzhu/ ral pa'i thor tshugs/ me tog dang rin chen/ dar dmar stod g.yog shing lo'i smad g.yog g.yas pus mo gdan btsugs/ g.yon mthil gdan btsugs/ bzhengs stabs ro gdan la bzhugs pa/ 'od dmar/ ༈ yang pad ljang zla gdan la ri khrod ma sku dang rtsa zhal ljang / g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ spyan gsum 'dzum khro g.yas dang po rdo rje/ gnyis pa dgra satwa/ gsum pa mda'/ g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gnyis pa shing lo'i sbrang yab/ gsum pa gzhu/ skra ser gyen brdzes/ me tog gis brgyan/ stag sham g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums gyis mi ro gnyis mnan pa/ ༈ yang pad dkar zla gdan la sher phyin dkar mo phyag chos 'chad kyi pad dkar dang pad dmar 'dzin pa'i me tog snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad dkar kha phye ba'i steng na pu ti re re 'dzin pa thor chung zur phud rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad zla la sher phyin ser mo gzhan gong 'dra las utpal sngon po'i steng na pu ti re re 'dzin pa/ ༈ yang pad dkar zla gdan la sher phyin ser mo dang po gnyis chos 'chad/ g.yas 'og skyabs sbyin/ g.yon 'og uta sngon steng pu ti/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad zla la dbyangs can ma sku dang rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar/ g.yas gsum na padma/ ral gri/ gri gug g.yon gsum na/ 'khor lo/ nor bu/ thod pa/ rgyan na bza'/ g.yon brkyangs/ ༈ yang pad dkar zla gdan la/

dbyangs can ma dkar mo g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad dkar/ de'i mdun rgyab g.yas/ g.yon du 'khor de 'dra ba bzhi/ thams cad kyang me tog dang mu tig rin chen sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ dar gyi na bza' sems skyil 'od dkar/ ༈ yang pad zla la dbyangs can ma dkar mo g.yas pad dmar/ g.yon pu ti rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad zla la dbyangs can ma dkar mo pi wang bsgyur ba/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad zla gdan la dbyangs can ma dkar po g.yas pad dmar/ g.yon pu ti/ thor tshugs spyan gsum/ zla phyed dbu rgyan/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ rten gtso bzhi pa phyag rdor dkyus 'gre/ 'di 'gyings bag che tsam/ pad zla la khro gnyer can ser mo g.yas mchog sbyin bgrang phreng / g.yon nor bus mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dang / spyi blugs/ 'dzum khro/ rgyan na bza' sems skyil/ ༈ yang pad ma zla gdan la/ rig byed ma dmar mo dang po gnyis utpala'i mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ g.yas 'og mas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon 'og mas uta dmar/ rin chen rgyan dang dar dmar na bza' 'od dmar/ mi mdog nag gi mgo la dbang phyug u ma'i steng na g.yon brkyangs skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ ༈ yang chos 'byung dkar po'i nang pad dmar nyi ma ro'i gdan la ku ru kulle dmar mo/ dang po gnyis mda' gzhu/ g.yas 'og mas utpal dmar po'i lcags kyu/ g.yon 'og mas uta dmar steng thod khrag skra ser gyen brdzes/ 'dzum khro spyan gsum thod skam dbu rgyan/ mgo rlon do shal/ rus rgyan/ stag sham/ g.yon brkyangs skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs/ ༈ yang pad dmar nyi zla'i gdan la rig byed ma dmar po dang po gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ bar pa gnyis/ lcags kyu dang uta dmar/ g.yas g.yon khu tshur bcangs pa g.yon gyi mkhrig ma'i steng g.yas kyi mkhrig ma bzhag pa rgyab sbyar ba'i mthe chung gnyis sbrel mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs pa/ 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/

rgyan na bza' dmar po rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad dmar nyi gdan la rig byed ma dmar mo/ rtsa phyag hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ g.yas g.yon gnyis pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ gsum pa gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ bzhi pa gnyis kyis mchog sbyin uta dmar/ rgyan na bza' dmar po rdor skyil/ ༈ de'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khor lha mo/ phyag bzhi ma ser mo/ dang po gnyis mchog sbyin uta dmar/ 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ lha mo mdun ma'i mdun du/ ro langs ma dmar mo/ g.yas gnyis sdigs mdzub lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis dril bu/ zhags pa/ g.yas kyi lha mo'i g.yas su mi thub ma ser mo/ g.yas gnyis dbyug pa lcags kyu/ g.yon 'dra rgyab kyi lha mo'i steng du/ ral gcig ma nag mo/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje lcags kyu/ g.yon 'dra/ g.yon gyi lha mo'i g.yon du ganda ri ser mo g.yas gnyis kha ṭwāṃ lcags kyu/ gtso 'khor thams cad spyan gsum/ rgyan na bza' g.yon brkyangs/ ༈ yang mtsho dkyil pad dmar zla gdan la rig byed ma dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum la/ g.yas me tog dkar po'i phreng ba/ g.yon bum pa ral thod/ rin chen me tog sbrul rgyan na bza' rdor skyil 'od dkar/ ༈ yang chos 'byung dkar po la gnas pa'i pad dkar nyi zla'i gdan la/ rig byed ma dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ bar pa gnyis skyabs sbyin dang pad dkar/ 'og ma gnyis phreng ba dang spyi blugs/ skra li gyen brdzes thod skam dbu rgyan/ mgo rlon do shal/ rgyan na bza' dkar po/ bya khyung gi steng na rdor skyil 'od dkar/ ༈ yang rnam rgyal mchod rten gyi nang pad zla la/ gtsug tor sku dang rtsa zhal dkar po/ g.yas ser/ g.yon sngo/ spyan gsum/ g.yas dang po sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar/ gnyis pa pad dkar la gnas 'od dpag med/ gsum pa mda'/ bzhi pa mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/

gnyis pa gzhu/ gsum pa skyabs sbyin/ bzhi pa bum pa/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang de 'dra ba gcig la g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon pad dkar/ g.yon du phyag rdor sngon po g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon utpal la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ gnyis ka zhi nyams/ rgyan na bza'/ mnyam bzhengs mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon du khro bo bzhi sngon po/ mdun ma'i g.yas ral gri/ g.yas pa'i g.yas lcags kyu/ rgyab ma'i g.yas dbyug pa/ g.yon ma'i g.yas rtse gsum/ bzhi ka g.yon sdigs mdzub/ skra kham gyen brdzes/ rin chen sbrul rgyan/ stag sham g.yon brkyangs/ gtso ma'i steng lha bu gnyis bum pa 'dzin pa/ yang pad zla la gdugs dkar sku dang rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas sngo g.yon dmar/ spyan gsum/ g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang rdo rje dkar po bar pa mda' gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis lcags kyu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ 'dzum khro rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang pad nyi ro gdan la tsa tsi ka dmar po zhal gcig spyan gsum/ g.yas gsum na rdo rje ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum na thod pa nor bu padma/ khro mo/ rus rgyan dang mi mgo'i phreng bas dbu rgyan stag sham/ skra ser gyen brdzes/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs/ ༈ yang pad ljang zla gdan la/ sor 'brang sku dang rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab sngo/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum/ g.yas bzhi na ral gri/ 'khor lo rtse gsum mda'/ g.yon bzhi na rdo rje zhags pa/ dgra satwa/ zhags pa gzhu/ rgyan na bza' g.yon brkyangs rol stabs 'od dmar/ ༈ yang pad ljang zla gdan la/ rma bya chen mo sku dang rtsa zhal ljang / g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum/ g.yas gsum na rma bya'i mjug sgro/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum na/ rin po che'i rnga yab/ gzhu/ bum pa/ rgyan na bza'/ zla ba'i rgyab yol/ skyil krung phyed pa/ ༈ yang pad ljang zla gdan la stong chen rab 'joms dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum/ g.yas gsum na ral gri/

mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum na gzhu/ zhags pa/ dgra satwa/ rgyan na bza'/ zla ba'i rgyab yol/ rol stabs/ ༈ yang pad ljang nyi gdan la/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin mthing nag khro mo zhal gcig spyan gsum/ g.yas gnyis na rdo rje/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis na dgra satwa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol/ rgyan na bza' rol stabs/ ༈ yang pad ljang nyi gdan la/ bsil tshal dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum/ g.yas na phreng ba mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis na lcags kyu/ pu ti thugs ka nyi rgyab sogs 'dra/ ༈ yang ri rab kyi steng sna tshogs rdo rje'i/ pad ljang 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla gdan la sor 'brang sku dang rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ rgyab ser/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum/ g.yas bzhi na/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ mda'/ ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na/ rdo rje/ zhags pa/ rtse gsum/ gzhu/ dgra satwa/ ral thod kyis rtser byang chub mchod rten chung ngu / me tog dang rin po che'i rgyan na bza' nyi rgyab g.yas brkyangs/ phyed skyil/ mdun du pad ljang nyi gdan la/ stong chen rab 'joms sku dang rtsa zhal nag g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang / rgyab ser khro mo spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ g.yas bzhi na mchog sbyin dang bcas pa'i rdo rje/ lcags kyu mda' ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ dgra satwa gzhu padma la gnas pa'i nor bu dbang rgyal/ skra kham gyen brdzes/ thod skam dbu rgyan/ rgyan na bza' rol stabs/ g.yas su sna tshogs pad zla la/ rma bya chen mo sku dang rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum/ g.yas bzhi na/ mchog sbyin bum pa/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na/ mnyam bzhag lhung bzed kyi steng na dge slong / rma bya'i sgro/ bum steng sna tshogs rdo rje/ rgyal mtshan/ rgyan na bza'/ nyi rgyab/ sems skyil/ rgyab tu pad ljang gdan la gsang sngags rjes 'dzin sku dang rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum/ g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis chos 'chad/

gnyis pa gnyis mnyam bzhag g.yas gsum pa mchog sbyin/ bzhi pa skyabs sbyin/ lnga pa rdo rje/ drug pa mda'/ g.yon gsum pa na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ bzhi pa gzhu/ lnga pa nor bu/ drug pa padma/ rgyan na bza'/ nyi rgyab g.yon brkyang / g.yon du pad ljang zla gdan la/ bsil tshal sku dang rtsa zhal ljang / g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum/ g.yas dang po skyabs sbyin/ gnyis pa rdo rje/ gsum pa mda'/ g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gnyis pa gzhu/ gsum pa rgyal mtshan/ rgyan na bza' nyi rgyab g.yas brkyangs/ ༈ pad nyi la phyir bzlog ma nag mo/ zhal gcig spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ g.yas gsum na ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum pad dmar/ rtse gsum/ thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa rgyan na bza' g.yon brkyangs/ ༈ yang pad nyi la rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sku dang rtsa zhal nag g.yas dmar/ g.yon ljang / mche gtsigs spyan gsum/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na kha ṭwāṃ dang 'khor lo/ skra ser gyen brdzes/ thod skam phreng ba dbu rgyan stod g.yogs ser po/ stag sham g.yon brkyangs/ ༈ yang pad zla nyi ma la g.yul sgrol lha mo sku dang rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dkar steng zhal dud kha/ mche gtsigs spyan gsum/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gtun shing dkar po/ ral li gyen brdzes/ thod skam dbu rgyan/ dar sngon na bza'/ g.yon brkyangs/ ༈ yang pad nyi la tshogs bdag glang sna dkar po/ lag gnyis rkang gnyis rgyan gos mgo g.yas bstan 'gyel ba'i steng gzhan gyis mi thub ma ser mo/ zhal gcig spyan gsum/ mche gtsigs g.yas thal mo brkyangs ste 'phyar zhing / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ rgyan na bza' g.yon brkyangs/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha gcig gnyis gdugs bzung nas skor ba byed pa/

༈ yang pad ljang nyi gdan la rdo rje gandha ri sku dang rtsa zhal nag g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab ljang / steng zhal ser po dang sngon po brtsegs pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ g.yas drug na rdo rje dril bu/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ 'khor lo/ g.yon drug na kha ṭwāṃ ga lcags kyu/ gzhu/ dgra satwa/ zhags pa/ thugs kar sdigs mdzub/ rgyan na bza' g.yon brkyangs/ yang pad zla la rdo rje lcags sgrog sku dang rtsa zhal ljang / g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ rdo rje lcags sgrog mda'/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ rgyan na bza' g.yon brkyangs/ ༈ yang pad ljang nyi dkyil la rdo rje lcags sgrog sku dang rtsa zhal ljang gu cung zad bzhad pa/ g.yas ser skya/ g.yon dmar zhing / gnyis ka khro gnyer/ mche gtsigs spyan gsum/ g.yas bzhi na skyabs sbyin/ rdo rje/ rdo rje lcags sgrog mda'/ g.yon bzhi na/ thod khrag sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ skra ser gyen brdzes/ rgyan zhum bu'i pags pa'i stod g.yog rol stabs/ yang pad zla la nor rgyun ma gtso 'khor lnga sku mdog ser/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon rin po che'i phreng ba/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ yang pad ljang zla gdan la/ nor rgyun ma ser mo/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon bum pa 'bras kyi snye mas kha brgyan pa/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ ༈ yang sna tshogs pad nyi la dzaṃ nag gcer bu rna ba ma phug pa skra kham gyen brdzes/ mche gtsigs/ spyan gnyis/ zlum rgyas/ sbrul rgyan/ g.yas thod khrag g.yon ne'u le/ g.yas brkyangs nor bdag rgyan gos na bza' lha lus ser po mnan pa/ ༈ yang pad nyi la dzaṃ ser dkyus 'gre/ ༈ yang pad nyi la dzaṃ bha la sku dang zhal gsum ser/ spyan gsum 'dzum khro/ g.yas gsum na shing thog dmar po/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon gsum gyi dang pos/ g.yon phyogs na gnas pa'i yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pas zhags pa dang bcas pa'i ne'u le/ gsum pas gzhu/

rgyan na bza' g.yas brkyangs/ ༈ yang pad ljang zla gdan la/ dzaṃ ser dkyus 'gre/ de'i mtha' skor du phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khor de 'dra ba brgyad/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi g.yon du nor rgyun ma ser mo re re g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma dang bcas yab la 'khyud pa rgyan na bza' bzhugs stabs gang bde/ ༈ yang rten gtso lnga par sgrol ljang dkyus 'gre/ zla ba dkar dmar gyi steng pad ma la/ nor rgyun ma gtso 'khor brgyad sku mdog ser po/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'bras snye/ rgyan na bza' rdor skyil/ de'i g.yas phyogs su gdan de 'dra ba la dzaṃ ser dkyus 'gre/ nor rgyun dzaṃ ser sku la 'khril ma gong 'dra dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du shar du gang bzang dmar/ lhor rnam sras ser/ nub tu nor sbyin dmar/ byang du bum bzang ser/ shar lhor 'jam 'khyil dmar/ lho nub tu rol phreng sngo/ nub byang du spyod dbang ser/ byang shar du sgo dbang ser/ phyag mtshan rgyan na bza' gtso 'dra/ gang 'di gnyis dang rgyab ma gnyis gral 'grigs bzang gi mdun du nor sbyin dang / nor chen/ rnam sras kyi g.yas su padma dang pad chen/ nor sbyin gyi rgyab tu ki li dang ki chen/ nor bzang gi g.yon du gang ba dang gang bzang / thams cad kyang gcer bu mdog ser dbang po 'phyang ba/ bi dza pu ra dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ bzhugs stabs gang bde/ nor rgyun ma gtso 'khor dgu dang dzaṃ bha la gtso 'khor rnams kyi phyir 'od gcig gis bskor ba go 'phang gi khyad bcas bran gtso bo'i mdun du bris na legs 'dra zhing / ༈ yang rten gtso'i steng pad ljang zla gdan la byams pa sku dang rtsa zhal ser g.yas dmar/ g.yon sngo zhi ba'i spyan gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad/ g.yas 'og ma mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'og ma yal ga sngon po me tog ser po bcas/ ral thod rgyan na bza' zla rgyab rdor skyil/ de nas g.yas g.yon mdun 'og sogs su cha snyoms par dgos la/

༈ yang pad nyi la hūm̐ mdzad nag po zhal gcig spyan gsum/ mche gtsigs/ phyag gnyis kyis rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad phyag rgya gong 'dra rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ skra kham gyen brdzes/ rin chen sbrul rgyan/ stag sham g.yon brkyangs dbang phyug nag po mnan pa/ ༈ yang pad dkar nyi gdan la stobs po che dmar po zhal gcig spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dang rnga yab dkar po/ g.yon gnyis thugs dkar thal mo gyen bslangs dang / sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ skra li gyen brdzes/ sbrul rgyan stag sham/ g.yon brkyangs 'od dmar yang pad nyi la/ bgegs mthar byed sngon po zhal gcig spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ skra li gyen brdzes/ rin chen sbrul rgyan stag sham g.yon brkyangs/ ༈ yang pad nyi la/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal sku dang rtsa zhal nag g.yas dkar/ g.yon sngo/ rgyab dmar/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ dang po gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdor dril/ g.yas gnyis pa ral gri/ gsum pa lcags kyu/ bzhi pa mda'/ g.yon gnyis pa gzhu/ gsum pa zhags pa/ bzhi pa rdo rje/ me tog sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang dar gyi stod g.yog sham thabs/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums gyis dbang phyug go rim gnyis rnal 'byor du ma bzhin mnan pa/ 'jigs byed dus mtshan ma bzhin gnon/ ༈ yang pad nyi la me ltar 'bar ba sku dang zhal bzhi nag mche gtsigs spyan gsum/ g.yas bzhi na rdo rje ral gri/ 'khor lo/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na/ dril bu/ gzhu/ zhags pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga ba dan sna tshogs kyis mtshan pa/ skra skya gyen brdzes/ sbrul rgyan stag sham/ zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyangs/ g.yon bskums gyis khyab mjug pho mo mnan pa/ ༈ yang pad ljang nyi gdan la/ rta mgrin sku dang rtsa zhal dmar zhing / zhi ba'i spyan gsum/ g.yas zhal sngon po mche gtsigs/ g.yon zhal dkar po aṃ gtsigs/ 'di gnyis khro ba'i spyan gsum/

g.yas bzhi na rdo rje dbyug pa/ mtheb mdzub sbyar zhing lhag ma brkyang ba'i phyag rgya/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi sdigs mdzub/ rang gi nu ma g.yon par 'dzugs/ padma/ gzhu/ skra ser gyen brdzes/ sbrul rgyan stag sham/ g.yon brkyangs/ ༈ yang pad ljang nyi gdan la/ rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig spyan gsum/ mche gtsigs/ rta mgo ljang g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dbyug pa/ skra li gyen brdzes/ thod skam dbu rgyan do shal/ sbrul rgyan stag sham rol stabs/ ༈ yang pad zla/ bum pa ser po'i steng rta mgrin sku dang rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ dbu steng rta mgo ljang / mche gtsigs/ spyan gsum/ dang po gnyis lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ gnyis pa gnyis mda'/ gzhu/ gsum pa gnyis thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga bzhi pa gnyis rdor dril/ thod skam dbu brgyan do shal/ skra li gyen brdzes/ g.yas gnyis brkyangs/ g.yon bskums/ mdun du/ rta rdor sngon po/ dang po gnyis mda' gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis keng rus dang thod pa/ g.yas su phag nag dang po gnyis zhags pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga 'og ma gnyis keng rus/ thod pa rgyab du ce spyang ser mo dang po gnyis ḍā ma ru thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis keng rus/ rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du lha dkar/ g.yas rdo rje/ 'di phyag gnyis/ g.yon thod pa/ 'di bzhi khro mo mche gtsigs/ spyan gsum thod phreng dbu rgyan g.yas brkyangs/ ༈ yang pad nyi la rta mgrin sku dang rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon nag dbu steng rta mgo ljang / mche gtsigs spyan gsum/ skra li gyen brdzes/ g.yas bzhi na sna tshogs rdo rje/ ba dan rkang gsum/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na ral gri dang bcas pa'i pad ljang / mdung / dbyug pa/ gzhu/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs kyi dang pos dbang mo dang sbrang rtsir byed ma/ gnyis pas rgyal bar byed ma dang bde gcod ma/ g.yas bskums dang pos dbang mo dang dpal mo/ gnyis pas 'dod lha'i chung ma rnams mdog sna tshogs gcer mo mnan pa/ ༈ yang pad ljang nyi gdan la gshin rje'i gshed nag po zhal gcig spyan gsum/

mche gtsigs/ skra li gyen brdzes g.yas rdo rje dbyug nag 'phyar ba/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ thod skam dbu rgyan/ mgo rlon do shal/ rus rgyan stag sham ma he dmar mo'i steng na g.yon brkyangs me ris 'bar ba/ ༈ yang pad ljang nyi ma ma he dmar po'i steng gshin rje sku dang rtsa zhal nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar mche gtsigs/ spyan gsum skra li gyen brdzes/ g.yas gsum na 'khor lo/ ral gri/ gtun shing / g.yon gsum na gsal shing gi phug pa'i ro/ dgra satwa zhags pa/ thod skam dbu rgyan/ mgo rlon do shal/ stag sham g.yon brkyangs/ me ris/ ༈ yang pad nyi la/ gshin rje sku dang rtsa zhal brtsegs ma gnyis nag g.yas brtsegs gnyis dkar/ g.yon brtsegs gnyis dmar/ mche gtsigs spyan gsum/ skra li gyen brdzes/ dang po gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ bar pa gnyis tho ba zhags pa/ mtha' ma gnyis/ ral gri/ gtun shing / thod skam dbu brgyan/ mgo rlon do shal/ rin chen sbrul rgyan stag sham/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis rdor skyil/ bar pa gnyis g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs/ rgyab ma gnyis/ g.yon bskums g.yas brkyangs me ris/ ༈ yang padma nyi zla'i gdan la/ phag mo dmar mo 'dzum khro spyan gsum/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar/ gru mor kha ṭwāṃ/ skra nag nyil ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug thod skam dbu rgyan/ mgo rlon do shal/ bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa/ g.yas brkyangs/ g.yon bskums kyis 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan pa/ me ri mdun du mkha' 'gro nag g.yon lā ma ljang / rgyab dum skyes dmar/ g.yas gzugs can ma dkar/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig 'dzum khro/ spyan gsum/ g.yas gnyis na ḍā ru gri gug g.yon gnyis na kha ṭwāṃ thod pa/ skra nag sil ba/ rus rgyan lnga/ gcer bu g.yon brkyangs/ de dag gi mtshams bzhir bum thod/ ༈ yang padma nyi gdan la/ phag mo dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum 'dzum khro/
